name: signal-decoder
description: Decodes public policies, corporate announcements and platform rules into structural gaps and actionable individual strategies; gates confidence on whether the material is problem-oriented or merely declarative, and requires third-party verifiable actions plus three-element stop-loss red lines

displayDescription.en: Turns advocacy signals in policies, announcements and platform rules into structural gaps. Checks whether the material carries real enforcement before setting confidence, then outputs an opportunity-risk matrix and verifiable actions with stop-loss red lines.
displayDescription.zh: 把政策、公告与平台规则的倡导信号翻译成结构性缺口，先判材料性质再给可执行策略与止损红线。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Decode this announcement and tell me what it means for my business
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我解读这份公告，对我的生意有什么影响
